snippet.title: Merchant Guilds Short Trailer
snippet.description:
From the creators of Merchant, Space Merchant, and Merchant Heroes comes the first multiplayer game in the series. 

Open the doors to the Merchant Universe.
Coming 2021.


Art by: 
Mario Castañeda - https://twitter.com/wrackune

Video by: 
Terry Nguyen - https://www.artstation.com/loremonger

Songs by:
Kevin MacLeod - https://filmmusic.io/song/4606-waltz-of-treachery
AJBreivik - https://soundcloud.com/ajbreivik/medieval-battle
